children.title: Overview
children.body: A chord-progression generator. It opens on FOUR EMPTY BARS in A minor -- four one-bar slots, all rests -- so nothing is written for you. Turn Chord Shape four times and you have a progression, or browse one of 160+ in three libraries on the Start bank.

children.title: The pads
children.body:
The BOTTOM ROW is the progression, always, on every bank and page: tap a pad to select that chord and play it, hold to sustain, release to stop. Bright is the chord sounding, lit is the selected one, dim is an empty slot, dark is past the end.

The three rows ABOVE edit whatever the bottom row selected, one parameter per row, each with its own colour so you can tell them apart: green, blue, magenta by position.

children.title: Pads: the pages
children.body:
Up / Down page the three parameter rows:
  WRITE  degree, length, quality
  VOICE  inversion, colour, chord octave
  FEEL   rhythm, gate, strum

Left / Right scroll a row through a list longer than eight -- all 24 rhythms, all 10 colours. Mute + Left/Right pages the chord row to chords 9-16. Every one of these puts a line on the screen saying what it did.

children.title: Buttons
children.body:
Copy duplicates the progression. HOLD Copy for halftime -- every chord twice as long. Mute + Copy for double-time, the exact inverse.

Undo steps back and captures every edit, not just the big ones; Mute + Undo redoes. Delete removes the selected chord.

Mute + jog click mutes a chord. Shift + jog click inserts a copy of it. Shift or Mute + jog turn changes bank. Back parks Stacks -- it keeps playing an armed take -- and the Tools menu brings it back; Shift + Back exits.

children.title: Main, Rate and Bars
children.body:
Length is an ABSOLUTE duration -- eighths of a bar, so 8 is one bar whatever else is set. Rate only chooses what a NEW chord gets; it cannot reach a chord you have written.

Clip Bars is the one loop length for what plays, what is drawn and what Stamp writes. It follows the music until you turn it yourself. While the buffer is still empty, Chords, Rate and Clip Bars settle each other -- any two give the third, and the one you turned last wins.

children.title: Harmony
children.body: Key, Octave Default and Scale live on Main and are LIVE: turning Key transposes what is already in the buffer, Octave Default moves it by octaves, and Scale re-snaps every chord you wrote BY DEGREE. A root you named on the Root knob, browsed from a library or read from a clip is exact: the scale does not move it, so a bVII stays a bVII. The staff names the chord that sounds. To shift it while it plays, use Clip Transpose (semitones) and Clip Octave on Clip: they move what sounds and what Stamp records, and leave what you wrote alone -- turn back to 0 and it is as it was.

children.title: Colour and Shape
children.body:
Chord Shape is the chord -- 38 of them, stored per chord and written to the clip. Shape Family is the coarse knob onto that same value, so the two are one setting; leaving a family and returning lands on its first chord.

Colour is VOICING, not density: close, open, the drops, shell, rootless, quartal, spread, cluster. Adding a note is Shape's job. Genre progressions are voiced by their style and ignore Colour; Common and Uncommon do not.

children.title: Voice Grouping
children.body: How the chords sit against each other, and where. `dynamic` leads each voicing from the one before -- real voice leading. The C1-B2 registers fold the progression into two octaves; the opens, drops and guitar space it out. Non-destructive, and Stamp writes what you heard.
